name: Kali: Call of Darkness
source:
When you're unexpectedly summoned to India to assist with an investigation, you don't know what to expect. Soon, you find yourself drawn into a terrifying web of murder and mystical powers...

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Kali:_Call_of_Darkness]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
你突然接到通知，要趕往印度協助調查，誰也沒告訴你會遇上什麼。你很快便發現，自己已被捲進一張由謀殺與神秘力量交織而成的恐怖大網……
